description: A review visit, both optional macros chosen against their defaults. gated: new_visit_note's own
if does not hold, so it is not placed; review_note's placement if holds; review_leaflet renders
its text. optional: followup_offer refused (default on, chosen off) and leaflet_offer chosen
(default off, chosen on). both: reference_line reads input.visit. The rest as
new-visit-defaults: prepend, append, signature, and the node macros around each item.
echoes: visit_echo reads macro.new_visit_note.content, inert (its own if does not hold), as
empty; quoted_review is chosen and reads deliverable.review_summary.content, the composed
sections without review_summary's own prepended letterhead. review_summary: its if holds.

inputs.consult_draft: Margaret Okafor, 71, seen for palpitations. Holter shows paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Started apixaban. (Fictional.)

outputs.section_draft:0: History paragraph: palpitations for two months.
outputs.letter_body: Letter body: palpitations from paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
